title: Sample ride · road bike on a trainer

coach.text:
Position summary for Road: race / aggressive.

Here is what to work on, in order of importance:

1. Reach looks short. Shoulder angle 76° (target 85–100°). You may feel cramped. A 10 mm longer stem (or extending aerobar pads forward) is a common fix.

2. Keep the chest open to avoid rounding. Your upper back curves slightly (6.2%). Cue a long spine and relaxed shoulders; if it worsens late in rides, check reach.

Golden rule: change one thing at a time, in small steps, ride for a few days, then re-test. Comfort and pain-free riding always beat textbook numbers.
